title: Teaching Mercy to Children through the Prophetic Example

text_simplified: Parents must teach children mercy and love from a young age, just as the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was a model in this. Mercy is not merely an emotion but a practical behavior that manifests in gentle dealings with both young and old. Reinforcing Islamic values in *tarbiyah* (upbringing) helps build a balanced personality for the child.

review_defects.why: The Arabic 'الأهل' can mean family or parents, but the English narrows it to 'Parents' only, potentially excluding other caregivers or family members involved in upbringing.
The Arabic uses the ordinary word 'التربية' (upbringing), but the English adds a transliteration '*tarbiyah*' which makes the text more clinical/academic than the warm, direct Arabic.
